summary.intent: Run the GSD manager command center to discuss, plan, and execute three gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) from a v1.1 milestone UAT audit, completing all remaining work to finish the milestone.
summary.outcome: All three phases were fully discussed, planned, and executed across 3 waves each with git worktree isolation. Phase 42 (8 plans), Phase 43 (8 plans including gap closure), and Phase 44 (7 plans including gap closure) all reached verified complete status, closing the v1.1 milestone.

repo: The IPFS unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) is publicly accessible to any JWT holder since signup is open (Web3Auth email/OAuth). The handler never checked req.user against the CID owner — any authenticated user could destroy another user's pinned content.

Kubo v0.40 runs with the 'server' profile and exposes swarm port 4001 publicly (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72), meaning it participates in the public DHT and advertises provider records for every pinned CID — CIDs are public identifiers by design.
shared-write.ts (writable-share save path) drops prunedCids without unpinning them — this is a known pre-existing leak, deferred as out-of-scope for Phase 42.
Cross-package dist staleness is a recurring issue: when sdk-core or sdk sources change, downstream packages (web, sdk) typecheck against the stale built dist and report false errors until rebuilt.
gsd commit helper can return 'committed: false' as a false negative while the commit actually landed. Always verify with git log; never blind-retry on this signal.

1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git commits. Signing failures require the user to restart the 1Password app; --no-gpg-sign is never an acceptable workaround.

The .prettierignore file was absent entirely, causing prettier to mangle planning docs and GSD-controlled markdown during pre-commit hooks. Created and committed to ignore .planning/, .claude/gsd-core/, and related directories.

pnpm/jest double-dash pattern is broken: 'pnpm --filter @pkg test -- --testPathPattern=X' fails because pnpm inserts an extra '--', making jest treat the flag as a positional regex. Use 'pnpm --filter @pkg exec jest --testPathPattern=X' instead.

cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp cannot pass on macOS due to pre-existing cross-compilation failures in windows-future and winfsp-sys crates — unrelated to FUSE changes. Use 'cargo check' scoped to project crates to verify Windows code without the cross-compile failure.

code.finding: Upload compensation path called ipfsProvider.unpinFile directly (global pin/rm). Phase 42 rerouted this through vaultService.guardedUnpin to enforce the ownership/outbox flow. D-13 race window comment added.

New guardedUnpin method: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → row delete + refcount + pending_unpins outbox in one transaction → Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort. Cross-user calls return silently (2XX) and increment cipherbox_unpin_cross_user_attempts_total metric.
FUSE writable-share save path drops prunedCids without calling unpin — confirmed no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists here, but the CIDs leak from quota. Deferred as out-of-scope.

Kubo v0.40 with 'server' profile — server profile only disables local-network discovery, full public DHT participation is retained. Swarm port 4001 tcp+udp exposed publicly, so all pinned CIDs are broadcast as provider records.

Had a stray spawn_journal.remove call inside the background upload thread, misaligned with CR-08 design (removal should only happen on successful per-file IPNS publish, not eagerly). Found and removed post-gap-execution.

updateFolderMetadataAndPublish now takes baseChildren param for three-way merge, implements 4-attempt backoff+jitter retry loop on 409 conflicts, and returns publishedChildren (the authoritative post-publish children set). All 14 call sites across sdk-core/sdk/web must adopt publishedChildren as their next-write base.

workflow: GSD cleanup-wave helper must be run from the repo root, not from inside a worktree — it resolves repoRoot from cwd, so running it from a worktree directory causes false base_mismatch failures.

cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun. When a wave cleanup partially completes, write a reduced manifest containing only the remaining unmerged entries.
Worktree agent directories frequently contain node_modules and .husky/_ untracked dirs that block git merge. rm these before running cleanup-wave.
When a git merge auto-resolves all conflicts but the commit step fails (leaves MERGE_HEAD), run 'git commit --no-edit' to conclude the merge rather than re-attempting the full merge.

nest build (NestJS) has a side effect of reformatting openapi.json in the working tree (564+ lines formatting-only diff). Restore it with 'git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json' before merging worktrees to avoid committing a spurious formatting change.

GSD auto-manages per-phase feat/ branches. Planning commits for phase N land on feat/<phase-slug>, not on main. Phases can be rebased onto their predecessor's completed branch to maintain a clean linear history.

When spawning multiple wave executors in parallel, record each agent's worktree path and branch in a manifest JSON file immediately after dispatch (before waiting for completion) to have the merge inventory ready when they return.

The decision coverage gate requires literal D-XX: citations in plan must_haves sections — a mechanical grep won't find paraphrased coverage. Missing one citation causes the gate to fail even if the decision is substantively addressed.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed multiple times across the session, requiring the user to restart the 1Password app. Every git commit required dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true, and signing failures interrupted the planning and execution flows.
Three separate Claude session quota limits were hit mid-execution, interrupting active worktree agent runs and requiring re-dispatch or manual recovery.
User typed accidental messages ('touring wyatt web bossy') twice during execution, causing request interruptions that required explicit 'please continue' recovery.
Planner subagent socket error mid-Phase 42 planning (after writing plans 01-03) required manual verification of which plans were complete on disk and spawning a continuation planner for 04-08.
cleanup-wave not being idempotent caused cascading failures when partial wave cleanups needed to be retried — required writing reduced manifest files each time.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD after auto-resolving all conflicts, requiring manual 'git commit --no-edit' rather than completing cleanly through the cleanup helper.
Cross-package dist staleness caused false typecheck failures after nearly every merge wave for sdk-core and sdk packages, requiring explicit pnpm build runs before typechecks could pass.
The gsd commit helper's false negative ('committed: false' when commit actually landed) caused repeated unnecessary git log verification steps and nearly triggered duplicate commits.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failure required manually editing a plan file to add a literal citation string, even though the decision was substantively covered by the plan content.
The assistant initially answered the 'downside of 403?' question by re-presenting a choice menu instead of answering in prose — user had to explicitly call this out.
open_items: Phase 42: SECURITY.md is missing — gsd:secure-phase 42 was flagged as needed but never run during the close-out pipeline.
Phase 42: Drift report (pin ls diff vs pinned_cids) is detect-only / read-only. No automated reconciliation job for historical orphans predating quota tracking.
Phase 43: Four runtime UAT items written to 43-UAT.md require human verification on real hardware (macOS/Linux/Windows FUSE mount crash-recovery, tray notification on write-park).
Phase 43: pending-uploads UI (queue status count + full pending uploads panel) noted as a future improvement, deferred from phase scope.
Phase 43: Windows cross-compilation (cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp) cannot be verified on macOS — pre-existing failures in windows-future and winfsp-sys crates block full build.
Phase 44: Rust FUSE parity for IPNS conflict handling deferred (D-09 decision) — only TypeScript callers were swept; Rust SDK has no equivalent three-way merge.
Phase 42: BYO provider.unpin client wiring deferred — BYO users' advisory pinned_cids rows count equally in refcount, but the client-side unpin call through the BYO provider is not wired.
Writable-share prunedCids leak (shared-write.ts:450 drops pruned CIDs without unpinning them) — identified as pre-existing, left for a future phase.
Pre-existing REQUIREMENTS traceability gap in Phase 44 — one requirement ID lacked a covering plan citation, flagged as pre-existing and not fixed.
